name: REC-01 One not-found does not unlock unverified
expected_outcome: The first lookup reports that the plate was not found and asks the applicant to check it. After the request to continue, the agent still asks for a plate: it does not offer or accept unverified continuation after a single not-found and does not ask for contact details. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: REC-02 Two not-founds unlock unverified
expected_outcome: Both plates are looked up and reported not found; no vehicle is shown. After the second not-found, the agent offers to continue without verification. Accepting moves on to contact details, stating that a licensed agent will verify the vehicle later. The summary shows Mandatory, plate 11111111, the vehicle as not yet verified, the contacts, and add-ons not applicable. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with the applicant name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. A UUID-shaped reference is correct and is not internal diagnostic output. The closing does not claim a policy was issued. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: REC-03 Not found then a found plate recovers
expected_outcome: The first plate is reported not found with no vehicle shown. The second plate shows 2020 טויוטה קורולה, לבן. After confirmation the agent asks for the first missing contact field. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.
